protocol.name: L2IP
protocol.integrity: CRC-32C Castagnoli over each header and its declared payload
protocol.rule: a successful transport transfer proves delivery only; a state-changing request succeeds only after a typed result reports the reached owner state

domains.name: RP
domains.role: nRF24, Sub-GHz, voice and U214 owner

domains.name: SAFETY
domains.role: AON heartbeat, lease, evidence and thermal owner

high_speed_header.deadline_rule: commands use 1..60000 ms measured from complete receipt; zero is legal only for messages that cannot create or extend a side effect
high_speed_header.duplicate_rule: message_id is monotonic per boot and direction; a duplicate request returns the cached typed result and never repeats a non-idempotent transition
high_speed_header.boot_rule: HELLO carries a fresh boot_id, so message_id reuse after reset cannot be mistaken for a duplicate from the previous boot

transports.physical: ESP32-C5 revision v1.0-or-later 1-bit SDIO, DAT1 interrupt, 20 MHz first target
transports.binding: Espressif ESP Serial Slave Link FIFO/register/interrupt transport
transports.qualification: silicon identity, external pull-ups, framed throughput, priority, reset recovery and simultaneous Wi-Fi/802.15.4 load HIL

transports.physical: dedicated 20-MHz full-duplex SPI1 slave plus active-low RP alert
transports.binding: 512-byte DMA cell; S3 clocks a zero-side-effect NOP cell when it needs only the RP upstream cell
transports.qualification: SPI1 slave DMA framing, CS abort, alert race, priority and aggregate-radio stress HIL

transports.binding: compact command/status mailbox plus a CRC-protected update window
transports.normal_policy: status is read-only to S3; no application command can admit cells or release the protected pack hold

transports.binding: compact command/status mailbox plus a CRC-protected update window
transports.normal_policy: S3 may publish a session heartbeat and request one bounded group lease; status and fault records remain read-only

priorities.name: telemetry
priorities.loss_rule: sequence gap and dropped count are reported; newest waterfall data wins

priorities.name: bulk
priorities.flow_control: receiver credits; zero credit stops bulk without occupying a control queue

scheduling.non_interference: bulk and telemetry are fragmented before admission; safety and control queues are never borrowed, and every owner enforces its own TX lease even if the transport stops

stream_fragment.rule: a fragment is independently checksummed by the common envelope; loss never shifts the boundary of a later fragment

messages.name: STATE_RESULT
messages.proof: owner state, operation_id and local timestamp

messages.name: QUIET_PROOF
messages.proof: TX request off, interface parked, switched rail state and local evidence state

messages.name: LEASE_RESULT
messages.proof: accepted lease_id, group, evidence mask and local expiry

messages.name: BOOT_REPORT
messages.proof: build_id, protocol range, capability hash, self-test result and pending/confirmed state

i2c_mailbox.update_rule: UPDATE_BEGIN carries target, length and SHA-256 metadata; every offset-addressed data window is acknowledged only after flash read-back; normal update is legal only in physical KILL

safety_timing.rule: the safety controller services TPS3435 only while its loop, S3 session, thermal inputs, power fault input, active lease and physical evidence are mutually consistent

evidence_register.read_rule: read both input-port bytes; ANY_TX_AON_N is the direct fail-safe aggregate, so a changing two-byte localization read may delay diagnosis but can never authorize TX
evidence_register.external_bit_rule: bit 8 comes from the 5-V-tolerant contact-5 boundary; stock U214 5V_OUT is inactive high, while only a signed and qualified evidence-aware Cap may assert open-drain low from measured final-feed RF

signal_groups.name: NRF24
signal_groups.tx_policy: one group lease permits any qualified simultaneous 3R/1T2R/2T1R/3T mix

signal_groups.name: U214
signal_groups.tx_policy: stock U214 receive and GNSS only; a transmit lease is available only to a signed evidence-aware LoRa Cap profile with qualified physical bit 8

signal_groups.name: M5_UNIT
signal_groups.tx_policy: receive-only by default; transmit requires a qualified module profile with an independent evidence contract

compatibility.minor: additive only; both peers must advertise the message and payload-schema hash before use
compatibility.bundle_rule: the signed manifest fixes the compatible protocol range and capability hash for every connected domain; S3 commits last
compatibility.failure: unknown mandatory message, schema mismatch, corrupt frame, expired deadline, reset or lost link revokes the local TX lease and leaves the owner quiet

telemetry and update saturation while control RTT and RP alert latency remain within contract
loss of every link during every state transition proves local lease expiry and typed quiet state
